children: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates:

The Nifty bulls are entering the final trading day of the week on an optimistic note, even as oil prices continue to remain at elevated levels. This is likely to be the second straight weekly gain for the index, the first time in nearly three months. Largecap stocks ruled the roost on Thursday and the bulls would hope that the trend continues on Friday as well.

A concerning part though will be the sharp reaction to results which kept the market breadth awry on Thursday and triggered the broader market underperformance. IT continues to remain in focus as the sell-off eased on Wall Street but the US-listed shares of Wipro and Infosys gained between 4% to 5% after the former's results. 23,000 remains key for the Nifty while the bulls would hope that the support now shifts higher to 22,750 - 22,700 zone.
